function: KDL-Transformer predicts dual variables and pinching-antenna positions from user locations, reconstructing transmit beamformers (KKT form) to maximize sum rate in PASS downlink (pp. 9-11).
system: Downlink MISO PASS: BS with N=K waveguides, L=8-32 pinching antennas each, K=4 or 6 single-antenna users, 30 GHz; no RIS (pp. 3, 11).
method: KKT-guided dual learning with a 2-layer encoder-decoder Transformer (also ResNet-50), unsupervised end-to-end training with negative sum rate loss on 30000 Monte-Carlo samples (pp. 9-11).
data_channel: Own simulator: LoS free-space spherical-wavefront channel from random user positions in 20x10 m area; 30000 Monte-Carlo training samples; no 3GPP model or measurements (pp. 4, 11).
test_conditions: 30000 simulated training samples; tests on 64 i.i.d. random samples for each setting of (P, L, K, Sx); no train-test mismatch of settings reported (p. 11).
baselines: Non-learned: MM-PDD (own optimization), conventional massive MIMO with hybrid beamforming (WMMSE-PDD), fully digital WMMSE; learned: purely data-driven Transformer and 50-layer ResNet, KDL-ResNet, KDL-Transformer-OCA (pp. 12-13).
metrics: Average sum rate (bps/Hz) versus training epochs, transmit power, antennas per waveguide, spatial range; execution time; MM-PDD convergence residual (pp. 12-13).
complexity: Orders: MM-PDD O(N_it N^3 L^3) dominant; KDL-Transformer inference O(J_D N_model N^2 L^2); execution time 0.0324 s/batch versus 255.51 s/sample for MM-PDD (pp. 7, 11-12).
q1_support: p. 4: "free-space spherical wavefront model". The channel is a custom LoS geometric model evaluated at random user positions (p. 11); the paper names no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "averaged over 64 i.i.d. random test samples". Tests are fresh draws from the same simulator for each setting of (P, L, K, Sx); the paper never says a model trained on one setting is tested on another, and reports no adaptation.
q3_support: p. 12: "purely data-driven Transformer and a 50-layer ResNet for" the same beamforming problem, plus non-learned MM-PDD and WMMSE-PDD massive MIMO. Table I (p. 12) compares sum rates, for example 49.76 for MM-PDD and 16.46 for the data-driven ResNet against 65.83.
q4_support: p. 11: "overall inference complexity is thus" O((J_E S_enc^2 + J_D S_dec^2 + J_D S_dec S_enc) N_model + ...); Remark 4 gives O(J_D N_model N^2 L^2) against O(N_it N^3 L^3) for MM-PDD, and Table I (p. 12) gives execution times.
q5_support: p. 11: "Reproducible code for KDL-Transformer is publicly available at" https://github.com/xiaoxiaxusummer/KDL_Transformer_Beamforming (footnote 3).
notes: Title on page 1 is Joint Transmit and Pinching Beamforming for Pinching Antenna System (PASS) and the DOI matches. Area 3: the learned output is the BS transmit beamformer plus pinching-antenna positions, a reconfigurable-antenna configuration comparable to RIS phase shifts, not antenna hardware design. ris is 0 because PASS is not a RIS. q3 counts only the purely data-driven ResNet-50 (a standard CNN trained end to end) as the learned baseline; the data-driven Transformer, KDL-ResNet and KDL-Transformer-OCA are variants of the proposed method and are not counted. Table I and the figures were read on page 12 of the PDF image.
